correctness.rationale: PASS. The scalar p-th moment CLT holds for p<2 under Var xi<infinity and for p>=2 under finite p-moment (implied by r=max(2,2p−2)). Hence Y_n(t)=n^(−p/2)|sum_{j<=nt}xi_j|^p are uniformly integrable for each t; iid independent coordinates permit a triangular coordinate WLLN by fixed truncation, variance <=K²/d, then K->infinity. For the published convexity decomposition ||S_m||_p^p=T_m+Q_m, T nondecreasing and Q martingale, quadratic variation has d × d^(−2/p) × d^(−(2p−2)/p)=d^(−1); MZ or Lyapunov bound E|sum_{j<=m}xi|^(2p−2)<=C m^(p−1) proves E Q_n²<=C n^p/d. Doob, finite-grid monotonicity and translated-block controls give uniform pairwise metric convergence, hence GH. No relation d vs n other than d->infinity; 1<p<infinity. The p=2 specialization is explicitly prior.
